candidates.change_summary: Delete the 'depositsCount++;' statement so deposits no longer increments the counter.
Replace 'depositsCount++;' with 'depositsCount--;' so a deposit decrements the counter instead of incrementing it.
Replace 'depositsCount++;' with 'depositsCount += 2;' so each deposit increases the counter by two.
Replace the require condition with 'require(false);' so every deposit to the contract reverts.
Replace the overflow-guard condition with 'require(depositsCount > 0);' so the first deposit reverts and subsequent behavior differs.
Remove the internal call to withdraw so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance to the owner.
Withdraw depositsCount wei instead of the full contract balance, changing how much ether is sent.
Move the `_` placeholder before the require so the protected function body executes before the owner check, letting non-owners trigger withdrawAll's effects.
